Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Pylon Vena Cava Filter is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5 T or 3.0 T when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Scan in First Level Controlled Operating Mode.
- Body transmit coil or head transmit coil.
- Any receive-only coil may be used.
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- B1+rms ≤ 2.4 uT.
- Scan for up to 30 minutes.
3 T scanning conditions:
- whole-body averaged SAR of 0.4 W/kg or less.
- head averaged SAR of 0.4 W/kg.
- Scan for up to 30 minutes.
The image artifact extends approximately 3 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
